# Reports: Get Inventory Summary Report Status

Area overview and notes: [reports.md](../reports.md)

`GET /reports/inventory-summary/{reportId}` · tenant-scoped token

Gets the status of an inventory summary report using the report ID returned from the POST endpoint. When the status is 'completed', a pre-signed download URL is included in the response (valid for 15 minutes). You can call this endpoint again to generate a fresh download URL. Reports are retained for 30 days.

**Status descriptions:**
- `pending`: The report is in the queue and has not yet started processing.
- `processing`: The report is currently being generated.
- `completed`: The report is ready for download.
- `failed`: The report could not be generated. Try again or contact support if the issue persists.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `reportId` | The unique identifier for the inventory summary report. |

**Response 200**: Inventory Summary Report Status

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data` | object | Yes |  |
| `data.report_id` | string (uuid) | Yes | The unique identifier for the inventory summary report. |
| `data.status` | string | Yes | The current status of the report. One of: `pending`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed`. |
| `data.as_of_timestamp` | string (date-time) | Yes | The point-in-time for which the inventory summary was generated. |
| `data.created_at` | string (date-time) | Yes | The timestamp when the report was created. |
| `data.completed_at` | string (date-time) | No | The timestamp when the report finished processing. Present only when status is 'completed'. |
| `data.expires_at` | string (date-time) | No | The timestamp when the report expires. Present only when status is 'completed'. |
| `data.download_url` | string | No | Pre-signed URL to download the report as a ZIP file. Present only when status is 'completed'. Valid for 15 minutes. |
| `data.metadata` | object | No | Report metadata. Present only when status is 'completed'. |
| `data.metadata.total_accounts_requested` | integer | No | The number of accounts requested in the report. |
| `data.metadata.total_accounts_included` | integer | Yes | The number of accounts included in the report. |
| `data.metadata.skipped_account_ids` | object | No | Details about accounts that were skipped. |
| `data.metadata.skipped_account_ids.not_found_in_organization` | array of string | No | Account IDs that were not found in the organization. |
| `data.error` | string | No | Error message if the report failed. Present only when status is 'failed'. |

**Errors:** 401 Unauthorized · 404 Report Not Found · 429 Too Many Requests
